title: A class constant whose value does not fit its type is reported only where it is read, under the wrong error.
text: `public const uint W = -1;` and `public const int S = "a";` compile while nothing reads them. A read of either is `E0792` ("has no compile-time value to inline"), whose help says the value must be a number, a string or an array of them, which both already are. A property default that does not fit its type is `E0472` at the declaration. It closes when a constant's value is checked against its declared type at the declaration, with a conformance case.
